title: Régi Magyar Exemplumadatbázis / Database of Old Hungarian Exempla (RMEx)
institution: ELTE BTK Magyar Irodalomtörténeti Intézet, Régi Magyar Irodalom Tanszék (edited by Bartók Zsófia Ágnes; OTKA PD 137996)
notes: Searchable database of the exempla (short moral stories) found in the old Hungarian-language codices, including the Domonkos, Margit-legenda, Érdy, Cornides, Székelyudvarhelyi, Érsekújvári and Teleki codices. Each record gives the exemplum text (a modernised reading taken from the printed Nyelvemléktár editions), a summary, keywords, the source codex and folio, and Latin sources and parallels. Version 1.0 appeared in 2014 and version 2.0 has been in progress since 2021; records were uploaded as recently as 2024. The counts cover the 'exemplum text' field of the record pages 0001 to 0386 and their lettered variants (for example 0016a); the codices named on the site are Hungarian-language manuscripts of the early 16th century (for example the Debreceni codex of 1519, the Érdy codex of 1526-1527 and the Érsekújvári codex of 1529-1531). The text is edited and modernised, not a diplomatic transcription. Searches use a web form; no bulk download was found. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No open licence. The front page requires that publications made with the database cite its data and location ('az adatbázis adatait és lelőhelyét fel kell tüntetni'); DOI 10.21862/Exemplum_2014 is registered but states no licence.
